data.name: ICBI_HeroDesc
data.value: Established as a specialized academic unit within the University of National and World Economy (UNWE) by a Council of Ministers Decree on 28 January 2026, the Institute for Cryptoeconomics, Blockchain and Innovation (ICBI) serves as the essential connecting link between traditional higher education, regulatory institutions, and the dynamic Web3 ecosystem.

data.name: ICBI_HeroQuote
data.value: Our core mission is to set the gold standard for cryptoeconomics education, empowering the academic and business sectors to seamlessly navigate new European regulatory frameworks, including MiCA.

data.name: ICBI_Pillar1_Desc
data.value: Development of innovative university programs, certification courses, and specialized training, building upon UNWE's established cryptoeconomics foundation.

data.name: ICBI_Pillar2_Desc
data.value: In-depth scientific analysis in the field of decentralized finance (DeFi), tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and the synergy between blockchain and artificial intelligence.

data.name: ICBI_Pillar3_Desc
data.value: Building a sustainable international network that unites leading universities, regulators, technology pioneers, and companies in joint projects.

data.name: ICBI_Pillar4_Desc
data.value: Engaging with government administration and regulatory institutions to support the smooth adaptation of the educational and business sectors to new European frameworks.
